with source as (
    select * from "warehouse"."main"."raw_events"
),

deduplicated as (
    select distinct
        cast(user_pseudo_id as varchar) as user_pseudo_id,
        event_date,
        event_timestamp,
        event_name,
        ga_session_id,
        page_location,
        page_title,
        device_category,
        country,
        traffic_source,
        purchase_revenue,
        to_timestamp(event_timestamp / 1000000) as event_ts_utc
    from source
)

select * from deduplicated

with events as (
    select * from "warehouse"."main"."stg_events"
),

ordered as (
    select
        *,
        lag(event_ts_utc) over (
            partition by user_pseudo_id order by event_ts_utc
        ) as prev_event_ts
    from events
),

flagged as (
    select
        *,
        case
            when prev_event_ts is null
                 or datediff('minute', prev_event_ts, event_ts_utc) >= 30
            then 1 else 0
        end as is_new_session
    from ordered
),

session_ids as (
    select
        *,
        sum(is_new_session) over (
            partition by user_pseudo_id order by event_ts_utc
            rows between unbounded preceding and current row
        ) as session_seq
    from flagged
)

select *, user_pseudo_id || '-' || session_seq as session_id
from session_ids

select
    session_id,
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_name,
    event_ts_utc,
    page_location,
    page_title,
    device_category,
    country,
    traffic_source,
    purchase_revenue
from "warehouse"."main"."int_sessions"

with events as (
    select * from "warehouse"."main"."fct_events"
)

select
    session_id,
    user_pseudo_id,
    min(event_ts_utc) as session_start,
    max(event_ts_utc) as session_end,
    datediff('second', min(event_ts_utc), max(event_ts_utc)) as duration_seconds,
    count(*) as event_count,
    sum(case when event_name = 'purchase' then try_cast(purchase_revenue as double) else 0 end) as session_revenue,
    max(case when event_name = 'purchase' then 1 else 0 end) as converted
from events
group by 1, 2

with steps as (
    select
        user_pseudo_id,
        session_id,
        max(case when event_name = 'view_item' then 1 else 0 end) as viewed,
        max(case when event_name = 'add_to_cart' then 1 else 0 end) as added_to_cart,
        max(case when event_name = 'begin_checkout' then 1 else 0 end) as began_checkout,
        max(case when event_name = 'purchase' then 1 else 0 end) as purchased
    from "warehouse"."main"."fct_events"
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    sum(viewed) as step_view,
    sum(case when viewed = 1 then added_to_cart else 0 end) as step_add_to_cart,
    sum(case when added_to_cart = 1 then began_checkout else 0 end) as step_begin_checkout,
    sum(case when began_checkout = 1 then purchased else 0 end) as step_purchase
from steps

select
    user_pseudo_id,
    min(session_start) as first_seen_at,
    max(session_end) as last_seen_at,
    count(distinct session_id) as total_sessions,
    sum(session_revenue) as lifetime_revenue
from "warehouse"."main"."fct_sessions"
group by 1

select session_id
from "warehouse"."main"."fct_sessions"
where session_id is null

select user_pseudo_id
from "warehouse"."main"."fct_sessions"
where user_pseudo_id is null

select
    session_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "warehouse"."main"."fct_sessions"
where session_id is not null
group by session_id
having count(*) > 1

with first_seen as (
    select
        user_pseudo_id,
        date_trunc('week', first_seen_at) as cohort_week
    from "warehouse"."main"."dim_users"
),

activity as (
    select
        user_pseudo_id,
        date_trunc('week', session_start) as activity_week
    from "warehouse"."main"."fct_sessions"
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    f.cohort_week,
    datediff('week', f.cohort_week, a.activity_week) as weeks_since_cohort,
    count(distinct a.user_pseudo_id) as active_users
from first_seen f
join activity a using (user_pseudo_id)
group by 1, 2
order by 1, 2

select user_pseudo_id
from "warehouse"."main"."dim_users"
where user_pseudo_id is null

with purchases as (
    select
        user_pseudo_id,
        count(*) filter (where event_name = 'purchase') as num_purchases,
        sum(case when event_name = 'purchase' then try_cast(purchase_revenue as double) else 0 end) as total_revenue
    from "warehouse"."main"."fct_events"
    group by 1
),

lifespan as (
    select
        user_pseudo_id,
        datediff('day', first_seen_at, last_seen_at) as lifespan_days
    from "warehouse"."main"."dim_users"
)

select
    p.user_pseudo_id,
    p.num_purchases,
    p.total_revenue,
    case when p.num_purchases > 0 then p.total_revenue / p.num_purchases else 0 end as avg_order_value,
    l.lifespan_days,
    (case when p.num_purchases > 0 then p.total_revenue / p.num_purchases else 0 end) * p.num_purchases as historical_ltv
from purchases p
join lifespan l using (user_pseudo_id)
where p.num_purchases > 0

select
    user_pseudo_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "warehouse"."main"."dim_users"
where user_pseudo_id is not null
group by user_pseudo_id
having count(*) > 1

with child as (
    select user_pseudo_id as from_field
    from "warehouse"."main"."fct_sessions"
    where user_pseudo_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select user_pseudo_id as to_field
    from "warehouse"."main"."dim_users"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null
